＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００１Ah, I've been waiting for you.￥There's something I want to￥show you...
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００２Sorry, but give me a moment.
Did you make something?
Something to show me?
What did you make?
Show me what?
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００３Just a little longer.￥You'll see soon enough...
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００４You'll understand the moment you￥see it. Just a little longer...
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００５Done.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００６Here it is.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿００７It's a hologram of Elan.＝＠０６２＿００８It's not done yet, but it has￥all the data we have. It's the￥closest image of Elan there is.＝＠０６２＿００９I wanted you to be the￥first to see it.
Me?! Why?
A miniature Elan!
Me?! Why me?
It's a tiny Elan!
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１０This hologram started out as the￥Earth hologram data you found￥for me.＝＠０６２＿０１１I sorted the Elan data,￥added it in, and built this.

＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１２Interesting reaction, as always.＝＠０６２＿０１３This Elan started out as the￥Earth hologram data you found￥for me a while back.＝＠０６２＿０１４I sorted the Elan data, added it￥in, and built this from it.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１５So I wanted to show it first to￥you, since you're the one who￥found the data.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１６I used to wonder why you would￥go out of your way for others.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１７But now, I think I￥sort of understand.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１８Every person thinks differently,￥and treats others differently.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０１９And meeting those different￥personalities helps us grow￥into new ones.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２０Until now, I never really faced￥people head-on.＝＠０６２＿０２１I didn't think it could be￥this interesting.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２２I'm grateful to you for making￥me realize that.
No need for thanks.
Aw, that makes me happy.
No need to thank me.
Aw, that makes me happy.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２３I see. Still, I wanted￥to tell you I'm grateful.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２４Being curious about you made￥me start noticing everyone￥else, too.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２５Ah, the display isn't stable￥yet. Hold on a moment.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２６I rushed to put it together￥as a hologram, after all...
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２７Right now it's 70 percent Earth￥data, but the more we learn, the￥closer it gets to the real Elan.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２８If I get to go to Elan,￥I plan to take this with me.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０２９I want to add new data I've￥gathered with my own hands and￥finish this hologram.
I'm sure you can do it.
That's a good goal.
I'm sure you can do it!
That's a wonderful goal.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０３０Yes. And for that, I intend to￥do everything I can to qualify.
＊Kairi＊＠０６２＿０３１Yes. For now, all I can do is￥give it my all to qualify.
＊Kairi＊＠０５１＿００１But even if I end up not being￥chosen, I don't think I'll￥have any regrets.
＊Kairi＊＠０５１＿００２I've gained that much from this.
＊Kairi＊＠０５１＿００３And I think it's thanks to you.￥Thank you...
